notes.title: Fatal Flight Expansion
notes.content:
[h1]Fatal Flight[/h1]
Take to the skies and ride Donna's broomstick while navigating through deadly traps in this new expansion!
[list]
[*] 1 New Game Available in Rapid Ryan's Arcade
[*] Online Leaderboards Available
[*] 1 Unlockable Achievement
[/list]


[h1]Happy Halloween![/h1]

notes.title: Menu Navigation Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]List of Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Menus can now be navigated with the D-Pad
[*] Fixed an issue where analog stick navigation was inverted
[*] Fixed an is where certain menu options could not be navigated to with the Gamepad
[/list]

notes.title: Costume Customization Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Customization Options[/h1]
[list]
[*] Customization Option added to the Main Menu
[*] Change Donna's appearance based on different cosmetics earned throughout the game
[*] Only available after beating the Story Mode
[/list]

notes.title: Various Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a typo in the ending cutscene.
[*] Fixed a bug in the credits where it would not exit automatically after finishing.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the final achievement from activating.
[/list]

notes.title: Big Crosshair Patch
notes.content:
[h1]New Crosshairs[/h1]
[list]
[*] 12 Different Types to choose from.
[*] 6 Different Colors: Pink (default), Blue, Green, Red, White, Yellow
[*] Found in the Gameplay Settings Screen
[/list]

notes.title: Colored Crosshair Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Crosshair Colors[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pink (default), Blue, Green, Red, White, Yellow
[*] Found in the Gameplay Settings Menu
[/list]


Open to any and all suggestions for future updates! Please keep them coming!

notes.title: Various Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some death VFX were not being triggered on certain levels.
[*] Fixed an issue where some spawn VFX were not being triggered on certain levels.
[*] The player will now become invulnerable when opening a chest/completing the level.
[*] Minor performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Arcade Quality of Life & Hotfix Update
notes.content:
[h1]Rapid Ryan's Arcade Mode[/h1]
[list]
[*] Instructions/How To Play Button added to the initial starting screen as well as score screen of each arcade game (previously only found in the pause menu).
[*] Instructions/How To Play screens added to Carrot Sweeper & Peg Solitaire.
[*] Various bug fixes in several arcade games.
[/list]

notes.title: Arcade Mode Additions & Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Arcade Mode Additions & Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tutorial Screens have been added for all arcade games (viewable through the pause menu).
[*] Beginner and Pro Scores added to all  arcade games (viewable on the pause menu).
[*] Achievements added for Leaping Lapin, Abnormal Aeronautics & Hopping Hare
[*] Fixed a bug where the initial jump on Hopping Hare was not being registered.
[*] Fixed a bug which prevented the game Leaping Lapin from being exited.
[/list]
